verdict.rationale: Unreal ships multiple documented public APIs for driving the editor/engine programmatically — Python scripting API, C++ API, Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API, and CLI/UAT automation — which directly support AI-native agentic control. However, there is no official Epic MCP server, the GitHub source repo is EULA/account-gated and returns 404 keylessly, and independent probes show community MCP wrappers are unmaintained and doc pages are unreliable for non-browser/agent clients due to WAF challenges. missing for 10: official MCP server or agent-native integration, reliable machine-readable API access without WAF/403 issues, and evidence of independent agent tooling actively using these APIs.
